summary: Telebugs is a lightweight error tracker that runs on your own infrastructure without a recurring subscription. It serves as an alternative to hosted error monitoring platforms like Sentry, capturing and recording application exceptions.
goodFor: It is suitable if you want to keep your exception data in-house and avoid SaaS subscription costs for basic error logging.
watchOut: The software is proprietary and currently lacks an established community history or active commit metrics, meaning support and updates may be uncertain.
deployNotes: Because it is distributed via Docker, you will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and place it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS.
